Three files matched only because `.` in the pattern is a regex wildcard. `comment-repository.ts` and `comment-thread.tsx` contain `comment.createdAt`, and `comment-item.tsx` contains `comment.createdAt` too, so I left all three out. Every other file contains the literal string `comment.created`.

Two of those files only mention it in comments, not in code. `src/server/services/comment-service.ts` also emits it in code at line 77, but `src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts` has it only in a doc comment (line 7). I kept that file because you asked for every textual occurrence, and the comment would go stale after the rename.
